1.desc: We believe that organizations grow when people grow with them. We are your strategic partner to attract talent and develop sustainable cultures.

HeroDual.footer_text: Leading consulting firm in executive recruitment and talent management

AboutUsBlock.title: About Us
AboutUsBlock.p1: Tailor Servicios was born in the Magallanes Region with a clear purpose: to raise the standard of human talent in organizations. Today, with operational deployment in Punta Arenas and Santiago, we have become the strategic partner of companies seeking to grow through their people.
AboutUsBlock.p2: We understand that every business is unique. That is why we design tailored solutions in Talent Attraction, Organizational Development, and People Management. We don't apply standardized formulas; instead, we immerse ourselves in our clients' culture to find the perfect fit.
AboutUsBlock.f2: Regional consolidation and strategic networking with executives and companies across all industries in the southern zone and nationwide.

BusinessLines.title: Our Services
BusinessLines.desc: Comprehensive Human Resources solutions designed to boost your organization's efficiency and growth.
BusinessLines.reclutamiento_desc: Tailored profile scoping, parallel executive hunting, competency assessments, and nationwide talent network with replacement guarantee.
BusinessLines.gestion_desc: Internal HR audits, payroll outsourcing, ERP optimization, labor wellbeing, and extreme zone tax incentive management.
BusinessLines.desarrollo_desc: Performance evaluations, climate diagnostics, compensation design, training programs, structural audits, and regulatory compliance.
BusinessLines.busqueda_desc: Confidential recruitment of C-Level roles and strategic positions with direct methodology.

TestimonialSection.title: Success Stories
TestimonialSection.subtitle: Measurable results and long-term relationships. Swipe to read more.
TestimonialSection.t1_quote: Tailor understood our corporate culture from day one. The executives they recruited shared our business vision. We reduced our turnover by 40%.
TestimonialSection.t2_quote: The work climate diagnosis was revealing. We managed to align our leaders and increase team productivity impressively.
TestimonialSection.t3_quote: We were looking for very specific talent for extreme operations. Tailor Servicios delivered exceptional candidates in record time.
TestimonialSection.t4_quote: They designed a custom performance management system. We went from bureaucratic annual evaluations to an agile and motivating model.
TestimonialSection.t5_quote: The outplacement process they managed for our departing executives was impeccable. Very human and oriented to real market results.
TestimonialSection.t6_quote: They helped us structure the entire commercial management from scratch. Their knowledge of the labor market and their evaluation methodology are unmatched.

SpecialProject.title: Join the excellence of The Cormorant at 55 South
SpecialProject.p1: At Tailor Servicios we are leading the recruitment process for the new boutique hotel The Cormorant at 55 South.
SpecialProject.p2: We are looking for professionals passionate about luxury hospitality in the Magallanes Region. Discover the opportunities and be a fundamental part of this unique project at the end of the world.

ContactSection.title: Let's talk about your team's future
ContactSection.desc: Leave us your details and a Tailor Servicios specialist will contact you shortly to understand your needs and propose the best strategic solution.

Footer.desc: Strategic consulting in Recruitment, People Management, and Organizational Development. Driving development from Magallanes.

CandidateBenefits.title: Why apply with Tailor Servicios?
CandidateBenefits.subtitle: The value we bring to your career
CandidateBenefits.b1_desc: We handle your background with the utmost ethical rigor. Your search remains private until you decide otherwise.
CandidateBenefits.b2_desc: Many of our searches are confidential and are not published on traditional portals. Access the best executive opportunities.
CandidateBenefits.b3_desc: We accompany you throughout the process, providing real feedback that will help you improve your professional profile.
CandidateBenefits.b4_desc: We work with the most important organizations in the southern zone, in sectors such as Aquaculture, Energy, Logistics, and Retail.

CandidateProcess.subtitle: Our Methodology
CandidateProcess.title: The path to your next challenge
CandidateProcess.desc: Our selection process is transparent, agile, and candidate-centered. We keep you informed at every stage, respecting your time and expectations.
CandidateProcess.s1_desc: Submit your resume through our official Rex+ portal. Only our consulting team will have access to your details.
CandidateProcess.s2_desc: When a matching opportunity arises, we conduct an in-depth interview to evaluate not only your skills but also your cultural fit.
CandidateProcess.s3_desc: We present your profile directly to the company's decision-makers, highlighting your strategic value.
CandidateProcess.s4_desc: Once selected, we accompany you during your first months to ensure successful integration.

TerminosPage.meta_desc: Terms and conditions, and privacy policy of Tailor Servicios.
TerminosPage.intro_text: Tailor Servicios is a B2B consulting firm located in Punta Arenas, specialized in Recruitment and Selection, People Management, and Organizational Development. This website aims to provide information about our services and serve as a contact platform for companies and candidates.
TerminosPage.privacy_title: 2. Personal Data Processing (Law No. 19.628 and Law No. 21.719)
TerminosPage.privacy_p1: In compliance with Chilean legislation on privacy protection and personal data, Tailor Servicios informs that it collects and processes personal data exclusively with the consent of its owners for the following purposes:
TerminosPage.privacy_li1: Companies (B2B Leads): We collect name, surname, corporate email, and company name for commercial contact purposes.
TerminosPage.privacy_li2: Candidates: We collect name, email, specialty, and Curriculum Vitae (CV) exclusively for evaluation in selection processes.
TerminosPage.privacy_p2: We guarantee that we DO NOT capture or store financial data, payment information, mandatory RUT (except for future contract formalization), nor do we track active geolocation.
TerminosPage.rights_text: As the data subject, you have the right to Access, Rectify, Cancel (Delete), and Oppose the processing of your personal data. To exercise these rights, you must send a request to the official privacy officer of Tailor Servicios:
TerminosPage.rights_p2: We will respond to your request within the deadlines stipulated by Chilean law.
TerminosPage.security_text: We implement reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, loss, or alteration. Your data may be processed through third-party software (CRM or cloud hosting systems) acting as data processors under strict confidentiality. We will retain your data (including CVs) for the time necessary to fulfill the described purposes, or until the data subject requests its deletion.
TerminosPage.cookies_text: This website uses cookies (small text files downloaded to your device) to ensure proper functioning and improve your browsing experience.
TerminosPage.cookies_li1: Essential Cookies: Strictly necessary for the technical operation of the site and to remember your privacy preferences (e.g., if you accepted or rejected the cookie banner). They do not collect personally identifiable information.
TerminosPage.cookies_li2: Analytics Cookies: Used in an aggregated and anonymous way to understand how visitors interact with the page, allowing us to optimize the user experience.
TerminosPage.cookies_p2: You can manage or revoke your cookie consent at any time by clearing the cookies from your browser settings.
TerminosPage.terms_2_text: Access and use of this website are exclusively directed to professionals and companies for commercial or B2B employability purposes. The use of the platform for illicit purposes, sending spam, data scraping, or any action that threatens the security and stability of our systems is strictly prohibited.
TerminosPage.terms_3_text: All content, design, logos, databases, texts, and images presented on this website are the exclusive property of Tailor Servicios or have the respective licenses. The total or partial reproduction, distribution, or modification of our content without prior written authorization is expressly prohibited.
TerminosPage.terms_4_text: Tailor Servicios strives to keep the information updated, but does not guarantee the uninterrupted availability of the website. We are not responsible for possible damages or loss of opportunities arising from technical problems, connection failures, or the misuse of the platform by third parties.
TerminosPage.terms_5_text: We reserve the right to modify these Terms and Conditions at any time by publishing the updated versions on this page. Any legal controversy derived from the use of this website will be interpreted and submitted to the jurisdiction of the competent courts of Punta Arenas, Magallanes Region, under the laws of the Republic of Chile.
